description: This file defines a MapStruct mapper interface 'LoanChargeMapper' which converts 'LoanCharge' domain objects into 'LoanChargeCommand' transfer objects, including a default method for mapping a set of 'LoanCharge' objects. It uses annotations to specify field mappings and expression-based mapping for 'amount'.

classes.name: LoanChargeMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct interface for mapping LoanCharge domain objects to LoanChargeCommand transfer objects.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a LoanCharge object to a LoanChargeCommand object using field mappings and expressions.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a set of LoanCharge objects to a set of LoanChargeCommand objects.
